title: Rosevean
html_source: The fact that the Rosevean is a “threemaster” means that it is the same ship that Stephen saw from the beach this morning.

anchor.prefix:
— Thank you, the sailor said. 

 He deposited the quid in his gob and, chewing and with some slow stammers, proceeded: 

 — We come up this morning eleven o'clock. The threemaster
anchor.suffix:
from Bridgwater with bricks. I shipped to get over. Paid off this afternoon. There's my discharge. See? D. B. Murphy, A. B. S. 

 In confirmation of which statement he extricated
